proof_requests: Video of the freezer plugged in and running, showing compressor sound and a thermometer placed inside over 15-20 minutes
Clear, legible photo of the rating/serial plate showing model, capacity, and manufacture date
Close-up photos of all rust spots and the base/underside
Close-up photo of the door gasket/seal, both open and closed
Photo of the power cord and plug condition
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Haier Thermocool chest freezer, so it can be priced at worst-case condition given unverified cooling performance, visible rust, and unknown age; seller's performance claims remain unverifiable remote until a power-on/cooling clip and legible rating plate are provided.
